neighbours.label: markers that a state persists regardless of a condition (regardless of, even when, year-round), as against statements that the state changes with the condition
fire: The pump keeps running regardless of the water level in the tank.
Some ducks stay on the lake year-round rather than flying south.
The coating stays intact even when the metal is bent.
Membership fees apply regardless of how often you visit.
The heater stays on even if the window is left open.
These shops are open year-round, including holidays.
The protein keeps its structure even after the bonds are broken.
The law applies to every company regardless of its size.
quiet: The pump stops when the water level in the tank is low.
Some ducks leave the lake in autumn and fly south.
The coating cracks when the metal is bent.
Membership fees depend on how often you visit.
The heater turns off if the window is left open.
These shops are open in summer and close for the holidays.
The protein loses its structure after the bonds are broken.
The law applies only to companies above a certain size.
